messages:
Infra SRE Bot: P1 ALERT  AuroraHealth (private VPC) — partial connectivity to private inference endpoints, 504 gateway timeouts reported. Paging oncall.
Sam R.: I'm oncall. Seeing 504 spikes from the tenant's private hostnames ~11:03 UTC. Graphs show connection_timeout metric rising in two AZs.
Priya N.: Any recent infra changes for that tenant?
Deploy Bot: Automated change: firewall-as-code/acl-sync applied to vpc-aurora at 2025-07-02T11:01Z by infra-automation (run-id fa-7782).
Marco (netops): Pulling NACLs and route tables now. Also checking NLB target group statuses.
Jules C. (CS): Customer reported errors to their internal SRE at 11:04 and asked if were seeing anything. They report an increase in inference request latency and intermittent 504s.
Sam R.: describe-target-health shows most targets healthy, but the NLB logs show repeated connection resets from 10.0.32.0/24 -> ports 49152-49250.
Marco (netops): NACL for private-subnet-3 shows a new deny rule for ephemeral port range 49152-65535 with higher priority. That matches the time of the acl-sync run.
Priya N.: Hmm, our healthchecks use ephemeral ephemeral ports for cross-zone probe responses. If NACL blocks them in two AZs, NLB thinks targets are unhealthy and requests get 504.
Sam R.: Quick mitigation: remove deny NACL or add explicit allow for 10.0.32.0/24 ephemeral range for the private-subnets. I can apply a temporary allow to get healthchecks passing.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: all remediation steps must be recorded here and in the change log.
Sam R.: Executing change (temp permit) now 
```
aws ec2 replace-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0f1e2d3c --ingress --rule-number 110 --protocol tcp --port-range From=49152,To=65535 --cidr-block 10.0.32.0/24 --rule-action allow
```
Sam R.: ACL change pushed. Waiting for propagation.
Marco (netops): Route53 note: we saw increased DNS latency for their private zone; checking resolver paths.
Jules C. (CS): I told AuroraHealth were applying emergency fix and will confirm when stable. They asked for an ETA ~15m.
Sam R.: Targets recovering in AZ-a and AZ-c, AZ-b still showing some failures. Polling NLB logs.
Priya N.: Additional issue: the firewall job also rotated a route table entry for the natgw in private-subnet-b to a stale natgw-id which is in a different AZ and doesn't support hairpin, causing some egress flows to fail intermittently. That explains AZ-b residual errors.
Sam R.: Proposed: 1) revert the problematic route table edit to original natgw-id for subnet-b, 2) keep NACL allow in place until we fix the automation, 3) shift traffic weight to us-east-2 fallback for 5 minutes if necessary.
Marco (netops): Reverting route now 
```
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1234 --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0f1a2b3c
```
Marco (netops): Route replacement confirmed. AZ-b health now improving.
Sam R.: Good. NLB target health now 19/20 healthy across AZs. Error rate back to baseline.
Oncall Bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by Sam R.  mitigation in place, monitoring.
Jules C. (CS): AuroraHealth: service appears restored. They will validate with load tests and report back. Requested RCA and weekly updates until fix.
Priya N.: Next steps: 1) add a guard to firewall-as-code job to ignore tenant-managed NACL entries (check tenant-manifest: protect_nacl=true), 2) add a preview/dry-run and change approval for route updates in private route tables, 3) update onboarding doc to document the ephemeral-port requirement for NLB healthchecks.
Sam R.: I'll open tickets: INF-2025-559 (automation guard), NET-2025-560 (route approval flow). Both assigned to infra-automation/team, SLA 72h for mitigations.
Night SRE: I'll take 3hr watch and will escalate if >10% targets unhealthy. Handoff at 11:28 UTC.
Jules C. (CS): Sent customer email: short outage summary + next steps, copied legal and account.
Deploy Bot: Change log: fa-7782 emergency change overrides: manual-acl-allow by samr at 2025-07-02T11:12Z; route-revert by marco at 2025-07-02T11:16Z.
Sam R.: Tagging incident: root_cause_candidate=automation-acl-rotation, impact=customer-visible-inference-504, mitigation=acl-allow+route-revert.
Infra SRE Bot: RESOLVED TEMP: AuroraHealth private VPC intermittent 504s mitigated after NACL allow and route revert. Postmortem to follow.
